value.description: Specifies that the value of the option is the value of an attribute of the option object
value.description_zh: 指定选项的值为选项对象的某个属性值

label.description: Specifies that the node label is a property value of the node object
label.description_zh: 指定节点标签为节点对象的某个属性值

:options.description: Specifies that the sub-option of an option is a property value of the option object
:options.description_zh: 指定选项的子选项为选项对象的某个属性值

disabled.description: Specifies that the option is disabled as a property value of the option object
disabled.description_zh: 指定选项的禁用为选项对象的某个属性值

value-key.description: The key name that uniquely identifies the value as an object type is required when the bound value is an object type
value-key.description_zh: 作为 value 唯一标识的键名，绑定值为对象类型时必填

clearable.description: Whether to display the clear button

collapse-tags.description: Whether to collapse tags into a text when multiple tags are selected
collapse-tags.description_zh: 多选时是否将选中值按文字的形式展示

multiple-limit.description: Maximum number of selections allowed in multiple selection mode
multiple-limit.description_zh: 多选时用户最多可以选择的项目数

name.description_zh: Select input 的 name 属性

allow-create.description_zh: 是否允许用户创建新条目

loading.description_zh: 是否正在从远程获取数据

reserve-keyword.description_zh: 是否保留选中项的关键词

no-match-text.description_zh: 搜索条件无匹配时显示的文字

no-data-text.description_zh: 选项为空时显示的文字

teleported.description: Whether to use teleport to move the dropdown to the body
teleported.description_zh: 是否使用 teleport 将下拉框移动至 body 元素下

append-to.description: The DOM element that the dropdown will be appended to. The value should be a valid CSS selector or an Element

persistent.description: Whether to keep the dropdown open after selecting an option
persistent.description_zh: 是否保持下拉框的展开状态

automatic-dropdown.description: Whether to automatically display the drop-down box

fit-input-width.description: Whether the width of the drop-down box is consistent with the width of the input box
fit-input-width.description_zh: 下拉框的宽度是否和输入框一致

scrollbar-always-on.description: Whether to always display the scroll bar

validate-event.description: Whether to trigger the change event when the value is changed
validate-event.description_zh: 是否在选中值发生变化时触发 change 事件

offset.description: The offset of the drop-down box

show-arrow.description: Whether to display the drop-down arrow

placement.options: top / top-start / top-end / bottom / bottom-start / bottom-end

fallback-placements.description: Fallback placements of the drop-down box

collapse-tags-tooltip.description: Whether to display the tooltip when the tags are collapsed
collapse-tags-tooltip.description_zh: 多选时是否将选中值按文字的形式展示

max-collapse-tags.description: Maximum number of tags displayed when tags are collapsed
max-collapse-tags.description_zh: 多选时最多显示的 tag 个数

popper-append-to-body.description: Whether to append the dropdown to body
popper-append-to-body.description_zh: 是否将下拉框插入至 body 元素

events.name: change
events.description: Triggered when the selected value changes
events.description_zh: 选中值发生变化时触发

events.name: visible-change
events.description: Triggered when the drop-down box appears/hides
events.params: 出现则为 true，隐藏则为 false
events.description_zh: 下拉框出现/隐藏时触发

events.name: remove-tag
events.description: Triggered when a tag is removed in multi-select mode
events.description_zh: 多选模式下移除tag时触发

events.name: clear
events.description: Clearable radio mode is triggered when the user clicks the clear button
events.description_zh: 可清空的单选模式下用户点击清空按钮时触发

events.name: blur
events.description_zh: 当 input 失去焦点时触发

events.name: focus
events.description_zh: 当 input 获得焦点时触发

slots.name: empty
slots.description: 自定义当选项为空时的内容
slots.description_zh: 自定义当选项为空时的内容

slots.name: tag
slots.description: select 组件自定义标签内容
slots.description_zh: select 组件自定义标签内容

slots.name: loading
slots.description: select 组件自定义 loading内容
slots.description_zh: select 组件自定义 loading内容

slots.name: label
slots.description: select 组件自定义标签内容
slots.description_zh: select 组件自定义标签内容

exposed.name: focus
exposed.description: 使选择器的输入框获取焦点
exposed.description_zh: 使选择器的输入框获取焦点

exposed.name: blur
exposed.description: 使选择器的输入框失去焦点，并隐藏下拉框
exposed.description_zh: 使选择器的输入框失去焦点，并隐藏下拉框
